title: Owens declares war on the US government: poltergeist attacks on Navy vessels
place_text: United States (Navy vessels, nuclear power plants)

tellings.quote: he said, "I'm declaring war against the United States government." And I would get newspaper clippings of poltergeist attacks on Navy vessels

plain: Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher with a doctorate who studies psychic claims, told podcast host Jesse Michels that in the early 1980s Ted Owens, a man who said he had psychic powers, announced, "I'm declaring war against the United States government." Mishlove says he then kept getting newspaper clippings from Owens about poltergeist attacks, meaning unseen forces causing havoc, on Navy ships and at nuclear power plants. If true, it would mean one man could strike at the military with his mind.
